# agentguard hosted

> A hard stop between an agent fleet and the bill that pays for it: spend caps and a kill switch per run, loops broken before they bill, destructive writes faked in dry-run with the diff, and a hash-chained audit log with published Merkle roots so the spend is provable afterwards. Bought by whoever owns the budget; connected in under a minute with `npx @agentwares/agentguard connect <key>`.

Bands, not a meter: Starter $29 (100K calls/mo), Pro $99 (1M), Team $299 (10M); soft alert at 80%, hard stop at 150% (error code BAND_EXCEEDED with an upgrade URL). Free trial: 1,000 calls/mo, started with POST /api/v1/signup {"accept_terms": true} — no human, no card. Per-customer MCP endpoint: https://agentwares-agentguard-proxy.vercel.app/<proxyId>/mcp with Authorization: Bearer <key>. Every refusal is an isError tool result whose text is JSON {code, cause, fix, retryable}: LOOP_DETECTED, CAP_EXCEEDED, BAND_EXCEEDED, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, KILL_SWITCH, TOOL_DENIED.

Every band includes overspend alerts and a verifiable audit trail. Overspend alert: the moment a per-run or per-day spend cap refuses a call, the operator is told once for that run (email via Resend, Slack, or Discord), with the run's spend and a link — never the payload. Audit export: any month's tool calls as a signed NDJSON file whose daily Merkle roots match the ones published on the public status page, so a reviewer can verify the chain offline and against /status/<proxyId>. On the first of each month every operator with a band is emailed the same spend report /report produces, for their own proxy, with the export link. Alerts and export are configured by the human who owns the bill at https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/dashboard/alerts and https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/dashboard/audit; both need a signed-in account.

Buying more calls without a browser: the bands are monthly subscriptions bought at a Stripe Checkout page, which an unattended agent cannot complete. POST https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/api/v1/calls buys capacity outright at $0.00029 per call — blocks of 1,000 to 5,000,000, so the smallest is $0.29 — added to this month's allowance on top of the trial or a band. Bought calls do not roll over. Three calls from cold: (1) POST https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/api/v1/signup {"accept_terms": true} for an ACCOUNT key, which says whose allowance goes up; (2) POST https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/v1/keys for a CREDIT key, which says what pays, and fund it in USDC over x402 (eip155:8453) with POST https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/v1/credits/x402 — no account, no card, no person; (3) POST https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/api/v1/calls {"calls": 1000} sending BOTH — Authorization: Bearer <account key> and X-Credit-Key: <credit key> — plus an Idempotency-Key so a retry is charged once. GET the same URL for the price first. A charge that fails to land is refunded.

## Links

- [Free spend report (no account, nothing stored)](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/report): Paste an agentguard audit export, a Claude Code session .jsonl, or a CSV of tool calls; get totals, spend by rail, loops, and the band whose cap would have stopped each overspend. JSON for agents at /api/report, or call the `agentguard_spend_report` tool on the MCP server at /api/mcp, which needs no key either.
- [Start the free trial (no human, no card, no CAPTCHA)](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/api/v1/signup): POST {"accept_terms": true} for an account key
- [Buy tool calls outright (no browser, no subscription)](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/api/v1/calls): POST {"calls": 1000} at $0.00029/call with an account key and a funded credit key; GET for the terms
- [Credit keys and funding](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/v1/keys): POST with no auth for a credit key; POST https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/v1/credits/x402 funds it in USDC with no human
- [Pricing (machine-readable)](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/pricing.json)
- [Management MCP server (Streamable HTTP)](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/api/mcp)
- [OpenAPI](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/openapi.json)
- [Public demo dashboard](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/demo)
- [Status page pattern](https://agentwares-agentguard.vercel.app/status/<proxyId>): daily Merkle roots, badge at /status/<proxyId>.svg, trust.json, merkle.json
- [Proxy health](https://agentwares-agentguard-proxy.vercel.app/health)
- [OSS proxy (self-hosted)](https://github.com/agentwares/agentguard): npx @agentwares/agentguard --config agentguard.yaml

## MCP tools

- `agentguard_get_pricing`: Machine-readable pricing for agentguard hosted: bands (Starter/Pro/Team) with included tool calls per month, the 80% soft alert and 150% hard stop, features, the free trial allowance, and `per_call` — buying tool calls outright at POST /api/v1/calls from a prepaid balance, which is the one purchase here an unattended agent can complete. Same data as /pricing.json.
- `agentguard_spend_report` (log, detail?): Read an agent log and report what it spent: totals, calls by tool and by class, estimated
dollars by rail, loops, the largest single run, and — for every overspend — the agentguard
band whose cap would have stopped it, the exact cap, and the call that would have tripped
it.

Needs no account and no key. The log is read in the request and discarded; nothing is
stored. Accepts an agentwares audit export (`agentwares.audit/v1`), a Claude Code session
`.jsonl`, or a CSV/JSONL of tool calls with any of `tool`, `ts`, `class`, `amount_usd`,
`rail`, `run_id`, `model`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`.

Caps come from the proxy's own default policy, so a band named here refuses exactly what
it says it refuses. Buying that band is a checkout a person completes; the calls-only
purchase an unattended agent can complete is in `agentguard_get_pricing` instead.
- `agentguard_create_proxy` (slug, upstreamUrl, upstreamName?, mode?): Create a hosted agentguard proxy in front of an MCP server. Returns the proxy id, the per-customer MCP URL and the proxy key (shown once). Point your agent's MCP client at the URL with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Requires an account key.
- `agentguard_set_policy` (proxyId, policyYaml): Replace a proxy's policy (YAML: mode, upstreams, classify, caps, loop, dry_run, approvals, alerts, chaos, drift). Validated before saving; takes effect within 30 seconds. Requires an account key.
- `agentguard_get_run` (proxyId, runId): The incident-shaped report for one run: counts (calls, reads, writes, faked, blocked, spend), the call timeline with decisions, dry-run mutations (what would have changed), ledger entries and the audit-chain verification. Requires an account key.
- `agentguard_export_audit` (proxyId, runId): Export a run's hash-chained audit entries (prev_hash, hash, redacted args) with the Merkle root, for disputes and questionnaires. Verify offline with sha256(prev_hash + canonical(entry)). Requires an account key.
- `agentguard_recommend_allowlist` (proxyId): Least-privilege recommendation from the proxy's recorded calls: the minimal tool allowlist, argument keys used per tool, and the upstream tools never used (remove them first). No LLM call here; apply it in the dashboard. Requires an account key.
